add_units_in_scope.heading: CAMPING
add_units_in_scope.reason: Private-property camping, stored personal property, municipal impoundment and disposal affect possession recovery and abandoned-property handling; municipal authority must not be mistaken for landlord self-help.

add_units_in_scope.heading: HARBORS—GENERALLY
add_units_in_scope.reason: Conditional harbor-front residential work and providers using waterways; definitions and commercial-activity permitting require section review.

add_units_in_scope.heading: BOATING REGULATIONS
add_units_in_scope.reason: Conditional residential docks and slips: pierhead restrictions, abandoned vessels and unauthorized docking affect waterfront physical work and property recovery.

add_units_in_scope.heading: HARBOR SANITATION
add_units_in_scope.reason: Shore-side waste, repair debris and hazardous discharges can affect residential work beside harbor waters; retain full chapter for section decisions.

add_units_in_scope.heading: REGULATION OF TREES
add_units_in_scope.reason: Tree permit, materials, excavation and protection requirements affect residential frontage work and repair access; §13.50.200 specifically regulates excavation near street/parkway trees.

add_units_in_scope.heading: GENERAL PROVISIONS
add_units_in_scope.reason: Definitions, scope and exceptions needed for existing parcel compliance and deferred-improvement dependencies.

add_units_in_scope.heading: IMPROVEMENTS
add_units_in_scope.reason: Deferred improvements and successor obligations can become payable or require work during existing-property repairs; includes work standards, warranties, inspections and acceptance.

add_units_in_scope.heading: ENFORCEMENT
add_units_in_scope.reason: Existing illegal subdivision conditions can affect occupancy, repair permits, certificates of compliance and remedies; new subdivision creation is not the only trigger.

add_units_out.heading: DISPLAYING FLAGS
add_units_out.reason: Flags on city property; not residential premises or contracted repair work.

add_units_out.heading: BEACH REGULATIONS
add_units_out.reason: Public beach recreation and conduct; residential harbor and shoreline repair dependencies retained separately in Chapters13.32/13.36/13.44.

add_units_out.heading: CAMPER FACILITIES
add_units_out.reason: City-operated recreational camping facilities; not residential tenancy turnover.

add_units_out.heading: SWIMMING RULES
add_units_out.reason: Public swimming-zone and diving behavior; not residential repair or departing-account work.

add_units_out.heading: PARKS
add_units_out.reason: Municipal park recreation and conduct; street/parkway tree work retained in Chapter13.50.

add_units_out.heading: PUBLIC BUILDINGS
add_units_out.reason: Conduct in civic/public buildings, including city parking; does not regulate residential maintenance.

add_units_out.heading: SPECIFIC EVENTS
add_units_out.reason: Special-event hosting and permits rather than residential repair delivery; revisit if §13.10 special-event camping is selected for an actual operating configuration.

add_units_out.heading: TENTATIVE MAPS
add_units_out.reason: Creation and amendment of subdivision maps is outside existing-residential repair scope; existing-condition enforcement retained in Chapter258.

add_units_out.heading: VESTING TENTATIVE MAPS
add_units_out.reason: New subdivision vesting-map process outside existing-residential repair scope.

add_units_out.heading: FINAL MAPS AND PARCEL MAPS
add_units_out.reason: Preparation/recording of new subdivision maps outside existing-residential repair scope; existing recorded maps remain factual evidence.

add_units_out.heading: DEDICATIONS AND RESERVATIONS
add_units_out.reason: New subdivision dedication/reservation requirements outside existing-residential repair scope; deferred improvements separately retained.

add_units_out.heading: REVERSIONS TO ACREAGE
add_units_out.reason: New parcel reversion transaction outside residential repair/outgoing-account scope.

add_units_out.heading: MERGERS
add_units_out.reason: Parcel merger transaction outside residential repair/outgoing-account scope; actual parcel status remains an applicability fact.
